name: C1
about: Plan C 3.8 script C1 (C4): terrain only, look full, pose rts80, CSV on. idle_visible 30 s, then hidden / visible idle phases (P4: terrain GPU = visible minus hidden at idle; the visibility switches run in phase `transition` so the idle phases hold steady-state frames only), then a 60 s seeded random walk cycling the five modes every 5 s at d 5/20/60/100 (P1, P2, P3 phases). Every stroke end rewrites its chunks' physics collision (C5), so the walk also yields cook and GT-apply samples. The walk runs at 30 Hz, so ticks per frame follow the frame rate; ticks_dropped counts the 15-per-frame catch-up cap. The same script with -ChimeraTerrainUnits=1000 is C1U (C9).
